units.source_text: 岛村被她那真挚的声音打动了。

en.t: Shimamura was moved by the sincerity in her voice.

units.source_text: 他锁紧双眉，哭丧着脸，强压住自己那股子强烈的冲动，已经感到索然寡味了。

en.t: He knitted his brows, looked miserable, and forced down that powerful impulse in himself until everything had already begun to feel flat and tasteless.

units.source_text: 他甚至在想是否还要遵守向她许过的诺言。

en.t: He was even wondering whether he should still keep the promise he had made to her.
